description: This file defines an interface for accessing S3 regional endpoint configuration options, specifically related to the 'endpoints_type' setting. It declares methods to retrieve the endpoints type and to convert the configuration into an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides method signatures for accessing S3 regional endpoints configuration options.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the endpoints type as a string.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
